title: Spyglass: Now Available for Enhanced Insights
summary: Spyglass is now officially launched, empowering all users with enhanced insights and improved functionality.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage all your embedded files, easily upload new ones, and choose how they appear within your content, all directly from a dedicated control panel.

title: Introducing Our Dynamic Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new, interactive roadmap page on our website, providing a transparent and easy-to-follow overview of our recently shipped features, upcoming developments, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more responsive experience with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Seamless Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Work together effortlessly with a refined real-time editing experience, featuring clearer indicators and enhanced ease for all collaborators.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests effortlessly, making teamwork more intuitive and productive.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control and direct involvement in the project's exciting future.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out extensive international language support, connecting you with our platform like never before.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade with polished existing themes and an exciting array of new ones to perfectly match your style.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Dive into your knowledge with a more powerful and personalized graph view, enabling seamless filtering by tags and time, and clear visibility into all your shared insights and collaborations.

title: Precision Search and Saved Views
summary: Refine your searches with powerful new filters and save your custom views as Compendiums, ensuring you always find exactly what you need, faster.

title: Enhanced Content Displays
summary: Experience more intuitive ways to view and interact with your linked information, helping you organize your thoughts and structure your notes with greater clarity.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting and Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility with Noeko by hosting it yourself or by selecting from new, feature-rich paid plans tailored to your needs.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're perfecting our homepage to greet you with the accurate time of day, ensuring a warm and personalized welcome every time you log in.

title: Enhanced List Management & Bulk Actions
summary: Effortlessly organize your tagged content and manage lists with new bulk actions, empowering you to quickly remove items from tags or delete them directly from the list view.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Unlock the power to effortlessly bring in and engage with diverse content from sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, transforming how you gather and utilize information.
